decisions.reason: The image count and placement are independent clauses already represented by the candidate's message-207 MODIFY; the internal-link change requires no additional image-state change.
The existing publication prerequisite already requires the applicable internal links to be added, so changing their applicability and destinations does not alter the publication rule.
The word-count target is established by a separate clause in the same message and is unaffected by the internal-link modification.
Changing internal-link applicability and destinations does not change the AI dolls blog's target audience.
The internal-link specification does not change the agreed article type, trial inclusion, or article count.
Internal-link destinations and per-blog applicability do not alter topic-selection constraints or the requested topic-and-keyword document.
The internal-link modification does not replace or otherwise change the selected blog keywords.
The source changes execution details for blog internal links, not the SEO plan's included service areas or content.
The internal-link decision does not change the keyword count, search-volume requirement, or replacement keywords in the report.
The source does not change meta-title or meta-description optimization requirements.
